execution_design.one_continue_scope: Once a future surviving MERA tranche is governed-started, one owner Continue carries that tranche through implementation, required validation, verified closeout, and next-tranche selection unless an OPS3 owner-only boundary or genuine external blocker is reached.
execution_design.preload_rule: Load only the selected surviving tranche and its declared dependency closure; block unrelated roadmap, benchmark and source archaeology.
execution_design.closeout_rule: Reserve at least 8 minutes of the 24-minute tranche target for focused validation, durable-evidence verification, reconciliation, and successor marking.
execution_design.split_rule: If the selected tranche cannot credibly leave the closeout reserve intact, split it before governed start rather than overrunning the tranche.
execution_design.retry_rule: Do not rerun an unchanged deterministic failure; classify the failure and require changed evidence before retry.

boundaries: MERA is the player/GM engineering/refit/rebuild/assembly orchestration layer; it does not become a second Item/Asset, crafting, salvage, vehicle, Profession, Project, economy, facility or rules ledger

LSS retains recoverable-object decomposition, salvage, partial stripping, donor-component lineage and extraction-output authority; historical MERA-17/18 retain only engineering planning/handoff/proof residuals
PPIA-03/D17 retain Item/Asset identity, ownership, custody, location, containment, condition, durability, installation/modification and history authority
MIB-12 retains crafting, repair, refurbishment, remanufacture, fabrication and transformation transaction authority
MIB-13 retains price, market, trade and service-economy truth
MIB-14/PPIA-04/F014 retain vehicle/platform/base/mecha/spacecraft/starship definitions, configuration/operation foundations and live authority

APW/D26 retains Project/task/participant/prerequisite/campaign-time/cancellation authority and DPL/Profession retains Character work capability and profession truth; historical MERA-19 does not survive as a parallel labor/project model
reduced MBES and MIB-14/PPIA-04 retain workshop/garage/hangar/facility/fleet context; historical MERA-21 does not survive as a parallel facility or scheduling owner
MRCS retains reusable component/interface/engineering-profile/compatibility-rule/work-recipe/blueprint-definition authoring authority
GPR plus Action/Event retain generic gameplay execution/replay; MERA supplies engineering-specific operations and adapters
PCA-12 and PDCP Packet 08 retain generic simulation/formal-analysis machinery; MERA-05/MERA-10 supply engineering models and interpretation rather than a new solver platform
PDCP Packet 07 owns shared proposal/preview/dry-run/commit/explanation/intervention/compensation semantics; MERA does not create a parallel generic studio framework
ARI/PCA retain generic identity/rights/provenance/version/review/import-export infrastructure; MERA-03 supplies engineering-domain serializers and validation only
engineering resolution may stop at the highest source-supported detail: Asset → system → assembly → subassembly → component → interface/connection → governed network
unknown or source-unspecified topology, capacity, compatibility, failure mode, network, hazard or operating envelope remains unresolved rather than fabricated
inspection distinguishes observed symptoms, suspected/isolated faults, identified faults, hidden truth and unresolved cause; engineering UI never grants omniscience
repair/wear/reliability/service/calibration/redundancy/failure/jury-rig behavior is definition-driven; MERA has no universal formula
Vehicle, Mecha and Starship engineering use one PPIA-04-backed adapter family with target-specific profiles rather than three independent engines
machinery/robotics/construct/industrial engineering remains a distinct adapter seam because its owner/control/facility bindings may differ from PPIA-04 vehicle semantics
no 3D renderer, physics sandbox or precision spatial manipulation is required for blocking engineering workflows; schematic/nonvisual operation has functional parity
optional AI is visibility-safe advisory only and cannot install, uninstall, dismantle, consume, fabricate, repair, spend, transfer, configure, approve hazards or declare an Asset operational
no paid/cloud provider is required for blocking engineering, planning, diagnostic, refit, test or validation workflows
proprietary benchmark products remain clean-room planning provenance only; protected code, data, formulas, authored content, UI expression, assets, save formats and private protocols are not copied
no MERA implementation authority exists until a future OPS3 CURRENT.json governed start selects a specific surviving MERA work item
